If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days and forecast is trending down, reduce the next 3-day forecast by 1.5–2.5% to avoid overcorrection.

If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is trending up, cap the next 3-day forecast at 1.5% below the 30-day moving average to prevent bullish overreach.

If sentiment is 0.33–0.67 and forecast is flat, add 0.5–1.0% to the next 3-day forecast to compensate for low sentiment bias.

If sentiment spikes to 1.00 in the last 2 days and forecast is trending up, increase the next 3-day forecast by 1.0–2.0% to reflect strong bullish momentum.

If sentiment is 0.00 and forecast is trending down, reduce the next 3-day forecast by 2.0–3.0% to account for bearish sentiment drag.

If forecast is >65.00 and sentiment is 0.67–1.00, reduce the next 3-day forecast by 0.5–1.5% to avoid overestimating price stability.
